title: Dashboards That Answer a Question
notes_html:
Ore is not gold. More charts are ore. A decision someone makes from the dashboard is gold.

This library's own example. The Patterns Tracker answers "what's published, in review and coming?" Plans in Motion answers "what needs me this week?" Each started from one question.

Related. The decision sentence is the value statement from Begin with the End in Mind. The Productivity-to-Headcount Trap is about measures that hold up. AI Friction asks whether to build it at all. Models Are Not Good at Math and Research Partner, Not All-Knowing Oracle keep the numbers honest.
strip: Paste this into any AI system's custom instructions or at the start of a conversation to run Dashboards That Answer a Question. It starts from the decision the viewer has to make, and builds only the figures that would change it.
